description: This file defines a React functional component 'ReviewStep' which renders a summary view of booking details for user verification before submission. It pulls data from a custom hook 'useBooking' and displays several 'SummaryCard' components with various booking information. The component includes a confirmation button that triggers a callback 'onConfirm' when clicked, if 'canSubmit' is true.

classes.name: SummaryCard
classes.description: A React component used within 'ReviewStep' to display individual sections of booking details with a title and content.

methods.name: ReviewStep({ canSubmit, onConfirm })
methods.description: Main React functional component that displays a review and confirmation interface for booking details.

methods.name: SummaryCard({ title, index, children })
methods.description: Helper React component to render each section of the booking summary with a title and children content.
